theorem clippedDeletion_cost_identities
    (n : ℕ) {Ω : Type u} (r : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hsym : ∀ a b : Ω, r a b = r b a)
    (C0 rho y : ℝ) (x : Fin n → Ω) (i : Fin n)
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hy : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y) :
    let M : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun j k : Fin n => r (x j) (x k)
    let psi : Fin n → ℝ := fun j : Fin n =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum M j
    let Lambda : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin n, (psi j) ^ 2
    let LambdaDeleted : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin n,
      (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident M i) j) ^ 2
    residualStatisticD n r x - residualStatisticDDeleted n r x i =
      psi i / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∧
    abs (abs (residualStatisticD n r x) - abs (residualStatisticDDeleted n r x i)) ≤
      |residualStatisticD n r x - residualStatisticDDeleted n r x i| ∧
    residualEnergyJ n r x - residualEnergyJDeleted n r x i =
      (Lambda - LambdaDeleted) / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2 ∧
    Lambda - LambdaDeleted = (psi i) ^ 2 +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (2 * M i j * (psi j - M i j) + (M i j) ^ 2) ∧
    studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x -
        studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C0 rho y x i =
      C0 * (residualEnergyJ n r x - residualEnergyJDeleted n r x i) /
        ((1 + rho) * y * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) ∧
    |studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho y x -
        studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C0 rho y x i| =
      C0 * |Lambda - LambdaDeleted| /
        (((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2 * ((1 + rho) * y * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) := by

theorem actual_quadratic_rho_moments
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o z, h o z = h z o)
    (hcenter : (∫ z : Ω × Ω, h z.1 z.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ z, h o z ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hwindow : y ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) /
      (2 * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :
    let C : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ z, h o z ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o z => h o z - g o - g z
    let v : ℝ := ∫ z : Ω × Ω, r z.1 z.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt v
    let a : ℝ := y / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let φ : Ω → ℝ := fun o => a * g o - (a * g o) ^ 2 / 2
    let w : Ω → ℝ := fun o => Real.exp (φ o)
    let m : ℝ := ∫ o, w o ∂μ
    let L : Ω → ℝ := fun o => w o / m
    let ν : Measure Ω :=
      μ.withDensity (fun o => ENNReal.ofReal (L o))
    let P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) :=
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
    let S : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, φ (ξ j)
    let Pₐ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := P₀.tilted S
    let F : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum (fun i j => r (ξ i) (ξ j))
    let ψ : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (fun j k => r (ξ j) (ξ k)) i
    let Λsq : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ i : Fin n, ψ ξ i ^ 2
    let u : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      ψ ξ i / ((n : ℝ) - 2)
    let J : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ i : Fin n, u ξ i ^ 2
    let D : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      F ξ / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    0 ≤ rho ∧ rho ^ 2 = v ∧
      μ.tilted φ = ν ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      Pₐ = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => ν) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure Pₐ ∧
      MemLp F 2 Pₐ ∧ Integrable (fun ξ => F ξ ^ 2) Pₐ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ => |F ξ|) Pₐ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, MemLp (fun ξ => ψ ξ i) 2 Pₐ) ∧
      Integrable Λsq Pₐ ∧ Integrable J Pₐ ∧
      Integrable D Pₐ ∧ Integrable (fun ξ => |D ξ|) Pₐ ∧
      (∀ ξ, J ξ = Λsq ξ / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, J ξ ∂Pₐ) =
        (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) / ((n : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2 ∧
      (∫ ξ, |D ξ| ∂Pₐ) =
        (∫ ξ, |F ξ| ∂Pₐ) /
          (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) ≤ rho ^ 2 *
        (4 * C ^ 2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) +
          48 * C ^ 3 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * a ^ 2 +
          96 * C ^ 4 * (n.choose 4 : ℝ) * a ^ 4) ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤ rho ^ 2 *
        (8 * C ^ 2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) +
          48 * C ^ 3 * (n.choose 3 : ℝ) * a ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, F ξ ^ 2 ∂Pₐ) ≤
        14 * C ^ 4 * rho ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + y ^ 4) ∧
      (∫ ξ, Λsq ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤
        14 * C ^ 4 * rho ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, J ξ ∂Pₐ) ≤
        56 * C ^ 4 * rho ^ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ ξ, |D ξ| ∂Pₐ) ≤
        8 * C ^ 2 * rho * (1 + y ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := by

theorem actual_quadratic_rho_weighted_deletion_bounds
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun z : Ω × Ω => h z.1 z.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ z : Ω × Ω, h z.1 z.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hwindow : x ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) /
      (2 * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :
    let C : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ z : Ω × Ω, r z.1 z.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let ρr : ℝ := Real.sqrt v
    let a : ℝ := x / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let φ : Ω → ℝ := fun o => a * g o - (a * g o) ^ 2 / 2
    let w : Ω → ℝ := fun o => Real.exp (φ o)
    let m : ℝ := ∫ o, w o ∂μ
    let L : Ω → ℝ := fun o => w o / m
    let ρ : Measure Ω :=
      μ.withDensity (fun o => ENNReal.ofReal (L o))
    let P₀ : Measure (Fin n → Ω) := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)
    let I : ℝ := m ^ n
    let R : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Real.exp (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, φ (ξ j)) / I
    let cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      min |a * g (ξ i)| 1
    let e : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ :=
      fun ξ j k => r (ξ j) (ξ k)
    let F : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum (e ξ)
    let Fdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Shao.OQ5.P35.unorderedPairSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident (e ξ) i)
    let ψ : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ j =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum (e ξ) j
    let ψdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i j =>
      Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.rowSum
        (Shao.OQ6.ResidualDeletion.eraseIncident (e ξ) i) j
    let Λsq : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, ψ ξ j ^ 2
    let Λdelsq : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, ψdel ξ i j ^ 2
    let u : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ j =>
      ψ ξ j / ((n : ℝ) - 2)
    let udel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i j =>
      ψdel ξ i j / ((n : ℝ) - 2)
    let J : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => ∑ j : Fin n, u ξ j ^ 2
    let Jdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      ∑ j : Fin n, udel ξ i j ^ 2
    let D₁ : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      F ξ / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let D₁del : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      Fdel ξ i / (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let cross : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i =>
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        2 * r (ξ i) (ξ j) * (ψ ξ j - r (ξ i) (ξ j))
    (∀ ξ i, Λsq ξ - Λdelsq ξ i = ψ ξ i ^ 2 + cross ξ i +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, r (ξ i) (ξ j) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * |D₁ ξ - D₁del ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ∫ ξ, R ξ i * cap ξ i * |D₁ ξ - D₁del ξ i| ∂P₀) ≤
          4 * Real.sqrt 2 * C * ρr * (1 + x) ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * |cross ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ∫ ξ, R ξ i * cap ξ i * |cross ξ i| ∂P₀) ≤
          16 * C ^ 2 * ρr ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * x * (1 + x) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * |Λsq ξ - Λdelsq ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ∫ ξ, R ξ i * cap ξ i * |Λsq ξ - Λdelsq ξ i| ∂P₀) ≤
          24 * C ^ 2 * ρr ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 + x) ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * abs (abs (D₁ ξ) - abs (D₁del ξ i))) P₀) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ∫ ξ, R ξ i * cap ξ i * abs (abs (D₁ ξ) - abs (D₁del ξ i)) ∂P₀) ≤
          4 * Real.sqrt 2 * C * ρr * (1 + x) ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, Integrable
        (fun ξ => R ξ i * cap ξ i * |J ξ - Jdel ξ i|) P₀) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ∫ ξ, R ξ i * cap ξ i * |J ξ - Jdel ξ i| ∂P₀) ≤
          96 * C ^ 2 * ρr ^ 2 * (1 + x) ^ 2 := by
